items.name: Forglemmegei
items.photoCredit: Zeynel Cebeci, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0, Myosotis sp. (not species-determined)
items.observations: Genus-level Myosotis study: branching upright and slender softly hairy stems, alternate entire narrow to lanceolate leaves, curling scorpioid cymes holding many small bright sky-blue rotate flowers with five rounded lobes and yellow-white throat ring. Younger buds are pinkish with hairy green calyces. Image provides recognizable forget-me-not flower form without diagnosing any one of the numerous species in Myosotis.
items.limitations: Explicitly not a species identification: Myosotis spp. describes a genus. Flowers may occur in pale pink, white and blue depending on species and developmental stage. Fuzzy floral arrangement and root/basal foliage are painterly abstractions; true species discrimination requires accurate calyx hairs, flower diameter, pedicel, fruit and habitat, which this illustration cannot establish. Licensed genus-level Wikimedia photo retained as a separate visual reference.
